title: P0 promotion protection and support-bearing decision

intent.outcome: Make protected master and the release workflows fail closed on one exact-commit, exact-artifact support-bearing promotion result.
non_goals: Do not create a generic hosted release service or duplicate domain checkers.
Do not claim #2448 closed until every release-critical child and a public rehearsal are complete.
Do not make canary or local development artifacts subject to the support-bearing gate.

parent.contribution: Implements #2454 and contributes the server-side/check-matrix domain to parent #2448.
parent.closure_boundary: Close #2454 only after workflow logic and live GitHub ruleset compose; keep #2448 open for remaining child/public-release evidence.

effects: Required PR/push CI covers the declared Python/Node and Windows/Linux boundary.
Release jobs obtain write authority only after a server-observed exact-commit check receipt.
Publication consumes a typed promotion result over existing artifact, semantic, security, package, license, runtime, and server receipts.

delegation.reason: This session explicitly prohibits spawning sub-agents unless the user requests delegation; the user requested cohesive PR lanes, not sub-agent work.

next_action: Implement the promotion contract/checker, workflow matrix and exact-commit admission, then configure and verify the live master ruleset.

claims: Direct updates and force pushes to master are blocked by an active server-side ruleset requiring PR integration and the aggregate support-bearing check.
Release preparation and publishing reject a commit whose exact server check receipt is missing, stale, mismatched, or failed before write authority is available.
The composed promotion result binds exact release artifacts and every release-critical typed receipt without duplicating domain logic.
Required CI and release matrices cover Python 3.13/3.14, Windows/Linux, Node 20/24/25 as declared, frozen lock verification, full root inventory, timeouts, and least privilege.
requirements: Inspect live GitHub ruleset and required-check state after applying it.
Run workflow syntax/action policy checks selected by Agentic Workspace.

continuation.residual_intent: Public protected-commit release rehearsal and any release-critical children outside #2454 remain parent-owned.
